latest_release.name: v4.3.4
latest_release.body:
> [!WARNING]
> We live in the era of big tech companies buying out OSS project maintainers left and right. Vuetify stays independent as long as community keeps the funds flowing to the OpenCollective. Our team is putting hundreds of hours in to keep the project going:
> - troubleshoot and fix top priority bugs as quickly as possible
> - review incoming PRs
> - deliver new features
> - maintain ecosystem tools
>
> If Vuetify is part of your stack, please consider [sponsoring the project](https://opencollective.com/vuetify) so we can continue delivering updates and fixes.
>
> Every contribution helps us keep Vuetify alive and signals to maintainers that their work matters.
>
> Thank you.

---

### :wrench: Bug Fixes

* **date:** count three months per quarter in getDiff ([#23384](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23384)) ([4506c94](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/4506c94d30f707713fe930b2a229680b2ea68e5a))
* **nested:** skip throttled registration after unmount ([#23395](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23395)) ([4932ba8](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/4932ba8b29428b218023c5c654ecf8b60e1ebda1))
* **VDateInput:** don't commit unchanged text on blur or Enter ([368f242](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/368f2427b95b60ee00dc5b5647a740107246db9b)), closes [#22808](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/22808)
* **VDialog:** close on back to the landing page ([#23334](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23334)) ([dd424ef](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/dd424efec4ecc92694f8e3d7f3b61c12884668c5)), closes [#18505](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/18505)
* **VFileInput:** avoid sizes like 1000.0 kB with show-size ([#23387](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23387)) ([34ef7c0](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/34ef7c0bd76ef6aa07eda287d5aeb501644b2ff1))
* **VOverlay:** prevent resize loop at fractional devicePixelRatio ([5f5faf5](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/5f5faf5bb90cf43583cbb5126c54306536aee259)), closes [#23406](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23406)
* **VOverlay:** close parent on click outside when a contained overlay is open ([#23400](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23400)) ([d863016](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/d8630169008cc9efefaec351692cb8fdfeb7a8cf)), closes [#22425](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/22425)
* **VProgressLinear:** avoid forced layout for idle loaders ([#23394](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23394)) ([abbe743](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/abbe74358416b9fc15f8a8c65d51f1f05582a88b)), closes [#23393](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23393)
* **VSelectionControl:** keep checked and indeterminate in sync when the model change is rejected ([1e3cb8b](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/1e3cb8bbb119de2b6bc81316ee27e6b3de93e8c2)), closes [#22689](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/22689)
* **VSnackbar:** restore tonal variant background ([#23408](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23408)) ([d6eda7e](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/d6eda7e126252b7b579cd78a333f1c39f0dc5332)), closes [#23407](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23407)
* **VSnackbar:** let Escape reach regular overlays, unless focused ([#23396](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23396)) ([6eacac6](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/6eacac606da33874b6322744ae30579bcbbb7c91)), closes [#23392](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23392)


### :microscope: Code Refactoring

* enable no-prototype-builtins linting rule ([2e588a6](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/2e588a6cc971f71c47086b3f49f51dab81de79e3))
* **VCalendar:** simplify category filtering ([4e51e60](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/4e51e60b54ed65ed711cb50677ae311e1270a3d4))
